tc-print|archetype-first-light-solitary.title: First Light Rings
tc-print|archetype-first-light-solitary.brief: A 12x16 in wall print: thrown-ring stripes framing a sunrise over a ridgeline, the sun drawn as the innermost ring. Flat colour in clay, sea glass and oat, with one warm peach glow at the horizon. Purely graphic, no faces.
tc-print|archetype-first-light-solitary.why_owner: Sunrise over a ridgeline shows up in 40% of your moments, so the sun sits inside the brand's rings.

tc-pillow|archetype-small-table-host.title: Table for Four
tc-pillow|archetype-small-table-host.brief: An 18 in throw pillow cover printed with thrown-ring stripes and a small dinner table for four detail in one corner: four plates seen from above as simple rings around one round table. Clay, oat and charcoal.
tc-pillow|archetype-small-table-host.why_owner: A dinner table for four shows up in 40% of your moments, so the corner holds your table.

tc-pendant|archetype-night-shift-builder.title: Late Wave Pendant
tc-pendant|archetype-night-shift-builder.brief: A sterling silver pendant in the shape of the wave-and-wheel mark (a ring crossed by one wave), with a small engraved desk lamp and crescent on the back for late desk sessions. No stones.
tc-pendant|archetype-night-shift-builder.why_owner: Late desk sessions show up in 45% of your moments, so the back carries a lamp and a crescent.

wk-runner|archetype-long-table-host.title: Long Table Runner
wk-runner|archetype-long-table-host.brief: A long linen-look table runner printed with gingham check, with a long table dinner parties detail repeated at each end: a row of place settings seen from above. Tomato, cream and butter. Purely graphic, no faces.
wk-runner|archetype-long-table-host.why_owner: Long-table dinner parties show up in 38% of your moments, so the runner is made for a full table.
wk-runner|archetype-long-table-host.public_tag: for people who host a crowd

wk-plate|archetype-long-table-host.title: Fresh Pasta Plate
wk-plate|archetype-long-table-host.brief: A dinner plate with a scalloped edge around the rim and a small nest of fresh pasta made from scratch at the centre. Cream with a tomato rim and one olive accent. Purely graphic.
wk-plate|archetype-long-table-host.why_owner: Pasta made from scratch shows up in 31% of your moments, so it sits at the centre of the plate.

wk-print|archetype-long-table-host.title: Market Morning
wk-print|archetype-long-table-host.brief: A 12x16 in kitchen wall print: a scattered citrus-and-herb repeat framing a farmers market mornings scene drawn as crates of tomatoes and lemons. Flat colour, purely graphic, no faces.
wk-print|archetype-long-table-host.why_owner: Farmers market mornings show up in 22% of your moments, so the print starts at the market.

wk-pendant|archetype-long-table-host.title: Candlelit Wishbone
wk-pendant|archetype-long-table-host.brief: A 14k yellow gold pendant in the shape of the wishbone, with a small engraved taper candle on the back for candlelit tablescapes. No stones, purely graphic.
wk-pendant|archetype-long-table-host.why_owner: Candlelit tablescapes show up in 27% of your moments, so the back carries a single taper candle.
